description: Poll a quick SMS order for the incoming verification code. Read-only. Call every 15-30 seconds after order_sms_verification until status is "received", then relay the code (and full message) to the user. Orders auto-refund if nothing arrives within 20 minutes. Requires a connected agent wallet.

orderId.description: The Order ID returned by order_sms_verification (also listed by list_sms_orders)

name: check_sms_verification
